name: Kesi Tallgrass
bio: Knows every trail on the savanna, and every trail you left.
notes: Lion in a Suit became Kesi Tallgrass (owner, 2026-11-25: "The lions are getting replaced respectively (one becomes lioness safari)"; name and bio ours, the owner can rename her). New model 2026-11-25 (owner: "many are replacements for what we currently have"; id and place kept, as Thornweaver's and Anoobys's swaps). Lion in a Suit's model until 2026-11-25 ("Lion in Suit T Pose", Meshy Community CC0) is retired to MapMaker as `meshy_lionsuit_classic`. Drive intake of 2026-11-25 ("safari scout lioness 15k", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner's own Meshy model (owner, 2026-11-25: "all are the owner's own Meshy creations"; standing rule since 2026-11-22).
